dcat_keyword_sm: Osoyoos Division of Yale Land District
dct_creator_sm: Jemmett, William Sugden (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Lower Similkameen Band reserves Alexis 9 and Ashnola 10 along the Similkameen River where it meets the Ashnola River. Land cover and features described on the map includes huts, graves, fields, ditches, and the typs of land and soil.
